facts.text: Lunch is a sandwich and a glass of milk, Streebek. Anything more and we'd be filing paperwork.
facts.why: Friday never says this. His real lines are about the dress code, the speed limit and using cutlery. A note in his by-the-book voice fits him, so it can stay as a note.

vibe.verdict: A neat cop cafeteria with the PAGAN joke, but the best food moments, the Brown Derby dinner and the chili dog, are left out.

Streebek's toast: 'may you live as long as you want but never want as long as you live' (Pep at the dinner)
The chili dog and the industrial sausage press warning (Pep and Friday)
The tank raid on the milk pasteurizing plant (Friday and Streebek)

Connie Swail thrown into the pit with the anaconda (PAGAN ceremony)

Swap 'Friday's LA diner meatloaf and gravy' for 'Brown Derby birthday dinner for Granny Mundy'.
